JUDGE BURST K1p-sig-jdg — which insignia glyph is nearest its written spec. task_id "K1p-sig-jdg". You are a separate instance; you have not seen any prompt or receipt and must not look for one.

Images 1, 2 and 3 are three candidate emblems. SPEC (ledger R-32): ONE vertical needle/gnomon with a small diamond head and a short foot, piercing THREE stacked horizontal strata bands (lowest widest, top narrowest); brass with a dark contour line; NO enclosing ring, shield or frame; NO text, clock, hourglass, compass or gears; TWO tones; legible at 8 px tall.
For EACH image answer, with one line of visible evidence each: needle_present, diamond_head, short_foot, three_strata, strata_widths_descending_upward, enclosing_ring_or_frame, forbidden_motif (text/clock/hourglass/compass/gears/star/wings: name it or 'none'), tone_count (integer), legible_at_8px (view it mentally shrunk: yes/no); then spec_fidelity 1–5 and register 1–5 (hand-drawn tapered dark contour, painted flat planes) with one-line reasons. Finally name nearest_to_spec (the image number) with one line why. Write out/judgment.json: {"candidates":[{"image":n, …fields…, "scores":{"spec_fidelity":n,"register":n}, "reasons":{…}}], "nearest_to_spec":n, "why":"…"}. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K1p-sig-jdg"; images []; files [out/judgment.json + sha256]; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS. Never PASS/FAIL.
